frozen_proposal_policy.note: Stage-4D localizer contract; identical to Phase-14 clean-v3 evaluator. NO change permitted.

frozen_downstream_behavior.refiner: SAME frozen regional refiner (epoch 56) as Phase-14; no parameter change
frozen_downstream_behavior.regional_preprocessing: crop_and_preprocess(raw_image, raw_mask, geom, target_size=256) -- 256x256 refiner crops
frozen_downstream_behavior.fusion_rule: P_final(x) = max_i(P_regional_i(x)) if x in union(ROIs) else P_global(x); MAX/DIRECT replacement in proposal union
frozen_downstream_behavior.proposal_union_handling: union of all top_k predicted ROI supports; global retained outside union
frozen_downstream_behavior.zero_proposal_rule: if no predicted proposals, fall back to GLOBAL everywhere (regional union empty)

scientific_question.primary: Why does the frozen Stage-4D predicted-proposal pipeline fail to transfer the strong Oracle-refiner potential (Do=0.8024) into practical performance (Dp=0.4185, R=0, Tp==Tg)?

candidate_mechanisms.A_PROPOSAL_SUPPLY_RECALL_LIMITATION: Localizer supplies too few / zero proposals to cover GT components (esp. tiny).
candidate_mechanisms.B_PROPOSAL_GEOMETRY_LIMITATION: Proposals geometrically miss the lesion (low coverage / poor crop context).
candidate_mechanisms.C_PROPOSAL_CONTAMINATION_LIMITATION: Proposals cover background / multiple lesions, contaminating the refiner crop.
candidate_mechanisms.D_PROPOSAL_RANKING_LIMITATION: An adequate proposal exists but is not top-ranked, so fusion/selection underuses it.
candidate_mechanisms.E_REFINER_DOMAIN_SHIFT_ON_PREDICTED_CROP: Refiner trained on GT/Oracle crops degrades on predicted-crop distribution.
candidate_mechanisms.F_MIXED_BOTTLENECK: No single dominant mechanism; multiple co-occur.

scientific_question.instruction: Do NOT assume. Classify via prospectively-defined evidence rules (see failure_attribution).

allowed_counterfactuals.A_BEST_CANDIDATE_ORACLE_SELECTION: Select best-existing candidate per component among already-generated frozen proposals (GT-assisted). Label ORACLE_SELECTION_WITHIN_FROZEN_CANDIDATE_SET__DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY. Non-deployable.
allowed_counterfactuals.B_GT_ASSISTED_FP_REMOVAL: Remove confirmed-background proposals (overlap no GT). Label GT_ASSISTED_FALSE_POSITIVE_DECOMPOSITION__NON_DEPLOYABLE. Non-deployable.
allowed_counterfactuals.constraint: Must NOT choose thresholds; descriptive causal probes only.
